findings.explanation: Does not satisfy customer-original-question-only protocol, even if numeric answers are absent. v3 is a separate disclosed deterministic task, not equivalent to original blind50.

Canonical raw v1 and current-csv v2 each have50 questions and no public_rules/evaluation_policy. Do not claim every published question file leaks rules. Official guide points to v2, while eval README also points to deterministic v3; current baseline selection is inconsistent.

findings.explanation: Keep guide/preflight and benchmark README evaluator-only; use unrelated technical probes and fresh sessions. Guide explicitly forbids A/B reading answer sets, but giving the whole guide/README would expose answers or historic metrics.

Source repo stores answer sets, gold facts, historical answer sheets and scores next to questions. Expected for maintainers; unsafe to mount entire repo/README into the evaluated-agent context. Runtime tar itself does not include bkn-eval.
